name: Lieke van der Meer
bio:
Lieke's path to motorsport began with a fascination for engineering, nurtured by her grandfather, a retired automotive engineer. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at Delft University of Technology, specializing in vehicle dynamics. During her studies, she gained practical experience through internships with various racing teams, focusing on data analysis and vehicle setup.

After graduation, Lieke joined Mitsubishi Motorsport as a junior engineer, quickly proving her organizational skills and technical acumen. Her ability to effectively communicate with test drivers and translate their feedback into actionable adjustments led to her promotion to Test Driver Coordinator. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where drivers and engineers work together seamlessly to optimize vehicle performance. Lieke is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her unwavering dedication to finding that extra tenth of a second.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair, often pulled back into a high ponytail
